scenes.text: Hello, little friend! I'm Bubu, and I'm so happy to see you today. We're going to talk about something very special: how to pay attention and calm down when things get a little too exciting. Are you ready to join me on this journey? It's going to be a lot of fun, and we'll learn so many new things together. Let's start our adventure!

Now, let's think about what it means to pay attention. Paying attention is like focusing on something important, just like when you listen to your favorite story. Imagine you're a superhero with special listening powers! When you pay attention, you can hear and see everything clearly, which helps you learn and have fun. Isn't that amazing? Let's see how we can use these powers every day.

To use our attention powers, we can practice a little trick called 'calming down.' When we feel too excited or upset, we can take three deep breaths. Let's try it together: breathe in slowly through your nose, and then gently breathe out through your mouth. Let's do it one more time! Doesn't that feel nice? Breathing helps our minds and bodies feel relaxed.

Great job! You're doing wonderfully. Remember, you can use this breathing trick anytime you need to calm down. Like when you're playing with your toys and need to take a break, or when you're feeling a bit wiggly before bedtime. You have the power to calm yourself down, and that's something to be proud of. Keep practicing, and you'll become a calming-down expert!

Let's talk about routines. Routines are like little plans we follow every day, like brushing our teeth in the morning or reading a bedtime story. They help us know what to expect and make us feel safe and happy. Do you have a favorite routine? Maybe it's singing a song while washing your hands. Routines make our days easier and more fun!

Now, let's create a simple routine together. First, we'll think of three things we do every morning. How about waking up, brushing our teeth, and having breakfast? We can even make it a game by pretending we're superheroes getting ready for the day. Each step is important, and doing them in order helps us start the day feeling great. Let's try to follow this routine tomorrow morning!

Did you enjoy making that routine? I hope you did! Remember, routines can change, and that's okay. Sometimes, we might add something new, like putting on our shoes before going outside. It's all about finding what works best for you. You're doing an amazing job, and I'm so proud of you for trying new things. Keep up the great work!

Let's talk about feelings. Sometimes we feel happy, and other times we might feel sad or angry. All feelings are okay, and it's important to know how to handle them. When we feel upset, it helps to talk to someone we trust, like a parent or a friend. Sharing our feelings can make us feel better and more understood. You're never alone with your feelings.

When you're feeling a bit down, you can try a fun activity to cheer up. How about drawing a picture of something that makes you happy, like a rainbow or your favorite animal? Creativity can be a wonderful way to express how we feel. And remember, it's okay to ask for a hug or some quiet time. Everyone needs a little comfort now and then.

You're doing so well! Remember, taking care of your feelings is just as important as playing and learning. Every time you practice calming down or following a routine, you're becoming stronger and more confident. Keep believing in yourself, because you can do amazing things. I'm so proud to be here with you on this journey.

Now, I have a question for you. What is something you can do when you feel a little too excited? Can you think of a fun way to calm down? Maybe you could try counting to ten or imagining a peaceful place. I'd love to hear your ideas. Sharing them can help others too, and we can all learn from each other.

Remember when we talked about routines? Let's think about how they help us with our feelings. Knowing what comes next can make us feel safe and ready. Like when it's time to clean up after playing, we know it's the start of something new, like snack time or a fun story. Routines help us feel comfortable and happy.

Let's practice one more calming activity. It's called the 'butterfly hug.' Cross your arms over your chest and gently tap your shoulders, like butterfly wings. It feels like a warm hug from yourself. You can do this whenever you need a little comfort. Doesn't it feel nice? Remember, you always have ways to feel calm and safe.

It's time to say goodbye, my dear friend. I'm so glad we spent this time together, learning about attention and calming down. You've done such a fantastic job, and I hope you remember all the things we've talked about. Keep practicing, and you'll continue to grow and shine. Until next time, take care and keep smiling. Goodbye!
